name: OpenStreetMap
description: Buildings, roads, parks, water and land surface from OpenStreetMap, loaded through Autark for a box or for named areas. Each layer arrives as the features an Autark map draws.

parameters.label: Area
parameters.description: A box, or the areas inside a place as OpenStreetMap names their boundaries.

resources.name: Buildings
resources.description: Building footprints, a building of several parts as one feature.

resources.name: Parks
resources.description: Parks, gardens, woods and other green space.

resources.name: Surface
resources.description: The land inside the area's boundary.

resources.name: All layers
resources.description: Buildings, roads, parks, water and surface, as one group of five datasets.
